label: Hammer
note: MH4U craftable hammer meta uses the Fatalis Iregard with Honed Blade, Challenger +2, Weakness Exploit, and Earplugs (often via Rock Steady), with Razor Sharp, Evasion, or Tremor Res as flex; relic hammers can exceed it. The model captures only Honed Blade's Sharpness +1 and Attack Up (L) components (+20 true raw). Challenger +2 (+25 true raw and +20% affinity while enraged), Weakness Exploit (+5 to the hitzone value on 45+ zones), Earplugs/Rock Steady, Razor Sharp, and Tremor Res are unmodeled. Critical Eye is only a filler in 4U because Crit Eye +3 is +20% affinity (not 3U's +30%), so it is not assumed; Element Atk Up (1.1x in 4U) is not used on this raw set. Focus is generally avoided on hammer because it speeds past the level 2 charge, and Critical Draw is not used. Sharpness uses MH4U's 1.05 green / 1.20 blue / 1.32 white / 1.45 purple table.
